page.overview:
What is Skeleton Crew?

The Skeleton Crew was a crew active from around 9 ABY. but did so in order to steal the mint on At Attin.

At first, the four younglings divided amongst themselves into two distinct groups. The boys, Wim and Neel, as one group and the girls, Fern and KB, as the other. However, during their adventures, the four, who had initially fought over who had "claimsies" on the ship and who got to be captain, learned to trust one another and became a single crew. During their trip to At Achrann, Wim, who had previously wished to be captain of the Onyx Cinder instead of Fern, asserted that Fern was the right choice for captain after all. He then added that, had he been captain, they would never have gotten as far as they had under Fern's leadership.

During the Mission to Skull Ridge Mountain, after Jod Na Nawood betrayed the Skeleton Crew over his greed and Wim saved KB's life when her prosthetics failed, the four grew even closer to each other. Fern then learned to take into account the limitations posed by both KB's prosthetics and Neel being a Myykian. As Neel was a member of an elephantine species, he was less capable of climbing than humans, such as Fern. KB and Neel, in turn, learned to assert their needs and desires, and all four learned to further appreciate each other. Fern came into her own, as captain, when both her leadership skills and her ability to delegate under pressure were tested as the crew narrowly escaped from a trash compactor while aboard the Onyx Cinder. A challenge that required the crew to both engage the emergency hull demolition sequencer while relying on the individual skills of each member of the crew.
